customSoftwareIndia.name: Custom software development
customSoftwareIndia.description: Affordable custom software development from India. Ladder7 builds web apps, business software, mobile apps and AI for clients in the GCC, Europe and Africa.

mainEntity.name: How much does custom software development in India cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on scope, integrations and team size. Ladder7 offers enterprise-grade quality at affordable, flexible pricing: a fixed quote for defined projects, a monthly fee for dedicated teams, or time and materials, agreed after a short discovery call.

mainEntity.name: Is it safe to outsource software development to India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, when the contract and process are right. Ladder7 works under an NDA, assigns code and IP to you, keeps code in your repository, and gives you access to staging environments and sprint demos throughout.

mainEntity.name: How long does a custom software project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A focused MVP usually takes 8 to 16 weeks. Larger business systems run in phases, with a usable release in each phase rather than one launch at the end.

mainEntity.name: Can you work with our existing developers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We can take full ownership of a product or add engineers to your team through staff augmentation.

mainEntity.name: Do you only work with clients in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Ladder7 has clients in the UAE, the UK (London), Germany, Ireland, the USA, Singapore, Australia, Vietnam and India, and takes on projects across the GCC, Europe and Africa, working remotely with meetings in your business hours.

hireDevelopersIndia.name: Dedicated software developers
hireDevelopersIndia.description: Hire pre-vetted React, Node.js, Python, AI and mobile developers from India on monthly contracts. Cost-effective teams for GCC, European and African firms.

mainEntity.name: What does it cost to hire a dedicated developer in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Monthly cost depends on role and seniority. Indian dedicated developers usually cost significantly less than equivalent hires in the GCC, UK or Western Europe. Ladder7 keeps pricing affordable and flexible, so share the roles you need and we will propose a team and monthly fee.

mainEntity.name: How quickly can a developer start?

acceptedAnswer.text: Shortlists are typically shared within a week. Start dates depend on the role and the developer's current commitments.

mainEntity.name: Will the developer work in my time zone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Developers align their day for overlap with your core hours. India is 1.5 to 2.5 hours ahead of the Gulf and 3.5 to 5.5 hours ahead of Europe, so a shared working window is easy to arrange.

mainEntity.name: Is pricing flexible?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Teams run on monthly terms, so you can scale developers up or down as your roadmap changes.

mainEntity.name: Who owns the code?

acceptedAnswer.text: You do. The contract assigns all intellectual property to you, and code lives in your repositories.

offshoreDevelopmentIndia.name: Offshore software development
offshoreDevelopmentIndia.description: Set up an offshore software development team or centre in India with Ladder7. Dedicated squads, onsite-offshore delivery and build-operate-transfer models.

mainEntity.name: What is an offshore development centre?

acceptedAnswer.text: An offshore development centre is a dedicated engineering team in another country, here India, that works exclusively for one client under that client's direction, while the partner handles hiring, facilities, HR and operations.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between offshore and outsourcing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Project outsourcing hands over a defined piece of work. Offshore development gives you a long-term team you direct, much like an internal department, with lower cost.

mainEntity.name: How big does an offshore team need to be?

acceptedAnswer.text: Teams can start with two or three engineers and grow as the roadmap expands.

mainEntity.name: Can we take over the team later?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Under a build-operate-transfer model, Ladder7 sets up and runs the team, then transfers it to your own legal entity.

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build an app in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: A simple app costs far less than a complex marketplace or fintech app. Ladder7 builds enterprise-grade apps at affordable, flexible pricing and provides a fixed estimate after a short discovery session.

mainEntity.name: Flutter or native: which should we choose?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flutter suits most business apps because one codebase serves Android and iOS. Native is better for heavy device integration, complex animation or very high performance.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build a mobile app?

acceptedAnswer.text: A focused first version usually takes 10 to 16 weeks including design, build, testing and store submission.

mainEntity.name: Do you publish the app to the stores?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We handle App Store and Google Play submission under your developer accounts, so you own the listings.

blogChooseCompanyIndia.headline: How to choose a custom software development company in India: a buyer's checklist.
blogChooseCompanyIndia.description: A practical checklist for GCC, European and African buyers choosing an Indian software development company: seniority, process, contracts, IP and cost.

mainEntity.name: What should I ask an Indian software company before hiring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ask who will do the work, how sprints and QA run, who owns the IP, how data is protected, which time zone overlap they offer and for references from clients in your region.

mainEntity.name: How do I avoid poor quality when outsourcing to India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start with a paid discovery or pilot, insist on code in your repository, review demos every sprint and agree acceptance criteria in advance.

mainEntity.name: Is India cheaper than Eastern Europe for software development?

acceptedAnswer.text: In most cases yes. India typically offers lower rates for comparable seniority, along with a larger talent pool.

mainEntity.name: Which outsourcing region is best for Gulf companies?

acceptedAnswer.text: India is usually the strongest fit for GCC companies because of cost, a 1.5 to 2.5 hour time difference, short flights and long-standing business ties.
